title: Iron provenance for the July 2021 Oxelösund steel trial

questions.reason: SSAB attributed its first steel, rolled at Oxelösund in July 2021, to the first hydrogen-reduced sponge iron shown from the Luleå pilot. A Swedish mining and metallurgy association bulletin gives a possible intermediate route via an Ovako melt and Oxelösund plate rolling for the August delivery. The bulletin provides no melt record, source for the Ovako claim, or tie to the first Luleå iron. The independently produced material evidence needed to resolve the candidate was not located.

findings: SSAB's 18 August 2021 release identifies July rolling and attributes its first steel to the first Luleå sponge iron. It gives no lot or heat identifier. The Swedish National Audit Office separately confirms the pilot first produced hydrogen-reduced sponge iron in 2021 without tracing it to Oxelösund.

The Svenska Bergsmannaföreningen summer bulletin describes Luleå pilot iron going to an Ovako electric arc furnace, then ingots going to Oxelösund for plate rolling and an August 2021 customer delivery. Its evidence base is unstated. It mentions an April 2022 talk by SSAB Special Steels CTO Jacob Sandberg in the ensuing discussion of the plant conversion. The association's recording archive required authentication and the talk was not available for inspection.

Ovako's FY2021 sustainability report describes a separate Hofors hydrogen heating project with Volvo Group. Volvo Group's FY2021 report and Jernkontoret's October 2021 launch coverage identify the Ovako collaboration as a source of hydrogen for fuel-cell vehicles. These sources do not verify the bulletin's Ovako melting account. The JRC profile and HYBRIT technical summary document Luleå pilot iron melted in Swerim tests without identifying the July Oxelösund rolling lot.

Volvo Group's October announcement confirms the load carrier used SSAB steel. Jernkontoret's event coverage associates the load carrier with the August delivery. Neither document identifies the heat or the originating Luleå reduction run.
frontier: Seek a 2021 Ovako electric arc furnace charge sheet, melt log or ingot dispatch note prompted by the association account. Match the incoming HYBRIT Luleå reduction lot identifier and the outgoing heat or ingot number against the SSAB Oxelösund July rolling log or mill inspection certificate.

An independently inspected chain-of-custody annex to the HYBRIT pilot closeout at the Swedish Energy Agency could also resolve the link. Volvo Group's August incoming-goods material certificate could corroborate the downstream heat or plate number if it can be matched upstream.

screen: Matched the Luleå and Oxelösund discoveries, their dated events and the existing candidate relation. Searched discoveries, sources and leads for HYBRIT and Oxelösund, and checked the previous manufacturing review. No new discovery or event proposed.
limits: Public English and Swedish source search through 17 November 2026. The first iron demonstrated by June, the July rolling, the August delivery and the October demonstration have distinct evidentiary scopes. The Ovako route is a lead with unresolved provenance.
